answer: The three words are derived from a 159 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. Because the karst nonce is published only after close, the lotus audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate lagoon derivation per key. That is 32 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
